intro: Pennsylvania's knowledge test has 18 multiple-choice questions — you need 15 correct to get your learner's permit. Our bank covers every chapter of the official online Pennsylvania Driver's Manual.

testTypes.name: Learner's permit (Class C)
testTypes.description: The 18-question knowledge test required before a Pennsylvania learner's permit is issued.

notes: The knowledge test consists of 18 multiple-choice questions. You must answer 15 correctly to pass.
It covers traffic signs, Pennsylvania's driving laws and safe-driving practices, and must be passed before a learner's permit is issued.

mockPresets.label: Full 18-question mock
mockPresets.description: Official format: 18 multiple-choice questions. Pass with 15 correct.

commonMistakes.text: Stopping too close to a school bus. Pennsylvania requires at least 10 feet, whether you're behind it or facing it.
commonMistakes.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — School Buses

commonMistakes.text: Treating a dark traffic signal like a green light. A non-working signal is a four-way STOP.
Using daytime running lights in work zones. Pennsylvania requires your actual headlights to be on.
commonMistakes.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — Work Zones

faq.q: How many questions are on the Pennsylvania permit test?
faq.a: 18 multiple-choice questions. You must answer 15 correctly to pass.

faq.q: How old do I have to be for a Pennsylvania learner's permit?
faq.a: You can apply when you are 16 or older. The permit is valid for one year.

faq.q: How many practice hours do I need before the road test?
faq.a: If you are under 18: at least 65 hours, including 10 at night and 5 in bad weather, and you must wait six months after the permit is issued.

questions.question: On Pennsylvania's learner's permit knowledge test, how many questions must you answer correctly?
questions.explanation: The knowledge test has 18 multiple-choice questions, and you must answer 15 correctly to pass.

questions.question: What does Pennsylvania's knowledge test measure?
options: Traffic signs, Pennsylvania driving laws and safe-driving practices
questions.correctAnswer: Traffic signs, Pennsylvania driving laws and safe-driving practices
questions.explanation: The test measures your knowledge of traffic signs, Pennsylvania's driving laws and safe-driving practices.

questions.question: What is the minimum age to apply for a Pennsylvania learner's permit?
questions.explanation: You may apply for a learner's permit when you are 16 years of age or older.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 1: Applying for a Learner's Permit

questions.question: How long is a Pennsylvania learner's permit valid?
options: One year from the issue date
questions.correctAnswer: One year from the issue date
questions.explanation: Your learner's permit is valid for one year from the issue date printed on your initial permit.

questions.question: Who may supervise a Pennsylvania junior learner's permit holder?
options: Any licensed driver age 18 or older
A licensed driver at least 21, or a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis or spouse who is at least 18
Any adult passenger, licensed or not
questions.correctAnswer: A licensed driver at least 21, or a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis or spouse who is at least 18
questions.explanation: You may only drive under the supervision of a licensed driver who is at least 21, or a parent, guardian, person in loco parentis or spouse who is 18 or older.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, how long must you wait after your learner's permit is issued before taking the road test (if under 18)?
questions.correctAnswer: Six months
questions.explanation: You must wait the mandatory six months from your permit issue date before the road test.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 1: Applying for a Learner's Permit

questions.question: How many hours of supervised behind-the-wheel practice must a Pennsylvania driver under 18 complete?
options: At least 50 hours, including 10 at night
At least 65 hours, including 10 at night and 5 in bad weather
questions.correctAnswer: At least 65 hours, including 10 at night and 5 in bad weather
questions.explanation: Drivers under 18 must complete at least 65 hours of skill-building, including at least 10 hours at night and 5 hours in bad weather.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 1: Applying for a Learner's Permit

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, where must you stop for a steady red light?
options: In the middle of the intersection
Before the marked stop line or crosswalk
Only if cross traffic is present
questions.correctAnswer: Before the marked stop line or crosswalk
questions.explanation: At a steady red light, you must stop before crossing the marked stop line or crosswalk.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 2: Signals — Red, Yellow, and Green Traffic Lights and Arrows

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, may you turn right on a steady red light?
options: Yes, unless a NO TURN ON RED sign is posted
Only if a police officer waves you on
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, unless a NO TURN ON RED sign is posted
questions.explanation: You may turn right while the light is red unless a NO TURN ON RED sign is posted.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 2: Signals — Red, Yellow, and Green Traffic Lights and Arrows

questions.question: When may you turn left on a red light in Pennsylvania (after stopping)?
options: From any left lane onto any street
From the left lane of a one-way street onto another one-way street
Only when turning into a driveway
questions.correctAnswer: From the left lane of a one-way street onto another one-way street
questions.explanation: After stopping, you may turn left on red if you are in the left lane turning from a one-way street onto another one-way street.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 2: Signals — Red, Yellow, and Green Traffic Lights and Arrows

questions.question: What does a steady yellow light tell you in Pennsylvania?
options: Speed up to clear the intersection
A steady red light will soon appear
questions.correctAnswer: A steady red light will soon appear
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light tells you a steady red light will soon appear.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 2: Signals — Red, Yellow, and Green Traffic Lights and Arrows

questions.question: What does a steady red arrow mean in Pennsylvania?
options: Stop; you may not turn in the direction the arrow points
questions.correctAnswer: Stop; you may not turn in the direction the arrow points
questions.explanation: A steady red arrow means you must stop and may not turn in the direction the arrow points.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 2: Signals — Red, Yellow, and Green Traffic Lights and Arrows

questions.question: What does a steady yellow arrow mean in Pennsylvania?
options: The protected or permitted turn is about to end
questions.correctAnswer: The protected or permitted turn is about to end
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means the movement permitted by the green arrow or flashing yellow arrow is about to end.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 2: Signals — Red, Yellow, and Green Traffic Lights and Arrows

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, a turn made during a steady green arrow is:
questions.correctAnswer: Protected
questions.explanation: A steady green arrow means you may turn the way it points, and the turn is 'protected.'
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 2: Signals — Red, Yellow, and Green Traffic Lights and Arrows

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, a flashing red light has the same meaning as:
questions.correctAnswer: A STOP sign
questions.explanation: A flashing red light has the same meaning as a STOP sign — come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean in Pennsylvania?
options: Caution — slow down, look and proceed with care
The light is about to turn green
questions.correctAnswer: Caution — slow down, look and proceed with care
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means CAUTION: slow down, look and proceed with care.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, a flashing yellow arrow means you may turn, but first you must:
options: Yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians
Come to a full stop for 3 seconds
questions.correctAnswer: Yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians
questions.explanation: With a flashing yellow arrow you may turn with caution, but you must first yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: How should you treat a traffic signal that is not working in Pennsylvania?
options: Like a YIELD sign for side streets only
Ignore it and follow the car ahead
questions.correctAnswer: Like a four-way STOP
questions.explanation: A non-functioning traffic signal should be treated as though it were a four-way STOP sign.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, what does a steady yellow 'X' over a traffic lane mean?
options: Change lanes — the lane's direction of travel is about to be reversed
The lane is for buses only
questions.correctAnswer: Change lanes — the lane's direction of travel is about to be reversed
questions.explanation: A steady yellow X means you must change lanes because the direction of travel for that lane is about to be reversed.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 2: Signals — Lane Use Control Signals

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, a steady red 'X' over a lane means:
options: You may use the lane with caution
You are not allowed to use that lane
The lane is for left turns
questions.correctAnswer: You are not allowed to use that lane
questions.explanation: A steady red X over a lane means you are not allowed to use the traffic lane.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 2: Signals — Lane Use Control Signals

questions.question: A pedestrian in Pennsylvania is already in the street when the flashing DON'T WALK signal begins. What should they do?
options: Stop in the middle of the street
Wait for the next WALK signal in the street
questions.correctAnswer: Finish crossing
questions.explanation: When the flashing DON'T WALK begins, pedestrians already in the street should finish crossing.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, which sign is the only octagon-shaped (8-sided) sign on the highway?
questions.correctAnswer: STOP
questions.explanation: The STOP sign is the only octagon-shaped sign you see on the highway.

questions.question: What shape is a YIELD sign in Pennsylvania?
questions.correctAnswer: Triangle
questions.explanation: YIELD signs are triangular (3-sided).

questions.question: What does a SPEED LIMIT sign in Pennsylvania indicate?
options: The maximum legal speed under ideal conditions
questions.correctAnswer: The maximum legal speed under ideal conditions
questions.explanation: A SPEED LIMIT sign indicates the maximum legal speed under ideal conditions for that stretch of highway.

questions.question: Pennsylvania warning signs are usually:
options: Diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background
questions.correctAnswer: Diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: Which Pennsylvania sign is the only pennant-shaped warning sign?
questions.correctAnswer: NO PASSING ZONE
questions.explanation: The NO PASSING ZONE sign is the only pennant-shaped warning sign.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, highway and expressway guide signs are:
questions.correctAnswer: Green with white letters
questions.explanation: Highway and expressway guide signs are green with white letters.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, what color are service signs (like gas, food or lodging)?
options: Blue with white letters or symbols
questions.correctAnswer: Blue with white letters or symbols
questions.explanation: Service signs are square or rectangular and blue with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: How are Pennsylvania work zone signs different from regular warning signs?
options: They are orange with black lettering instead of yellow
questions.correctAnswer: They are orange with black lettering instead of yellow
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are normally diamond-shaped like warning signs, but orange with black lettering.

questions.question: Which sign is the only pentagon-shaped sign used on Pennsylvania roads?
questions.correctAnswer: SCHOOL
questions.explanation: The SCHOOL sign is the only pentagon-shaped sign used on the roadway.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, how should you treat a railroad crossbuck sign?
questions.correctAnswer: As a YIELD sign
questions.explanation: You should treat the crossbuck sign as a YIELD sign.

questions.question: On Pennsylvania roads, yellow lines divide:
questions.correctAnswer: Traffic traveling in opposite directions
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic traveling in opposite directions.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, solid white lines divide:
options: Lanes of traffic traveling in the same direction
Only the shoulder from the road
questions.correctAnswer: Lanes of traffic traveling in the same direction
questions.explanation: Solid white lines divide lanes of traffic traveling in the same direction.

questions.question: On a Pennsylvania road with a solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line, when may you pass?
options: When the broken line is on your side and it is safe
When the solid line is on your side
questions.correctAnswer: When the broken line is on your side and it is safe
questions.explanation: You may pass if the broken line is on your side of the road and safe conditions exist.

questions.question: A double solid yellow centerline in Pennsylvania means:
options: Passing is allowed in both directions
Passing is not allowed for traffic in either direction
Passing is allowed only for motorcycles
questions.correctAnswer: Passing is not allowed for traffic in either direction
questions.explanation: Passing by traffic traveling in either direction is not allowed on roads marked with a double solid yellow centerline.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, how may vehicles use a center lane marked for two-way left turns?
options: Only to make left turns, from either direction
As a travel lane in heavy traffic
questions.correctAnswer: Only to make left turns, from either direction
questions.explanation: Vehicles traveling in either direction may use the center lane only to make left turns.

questions.question: When a Pennsylvania school bus has flashing red lights and its stop arm extended, how far away must you stop?
questions.correctAnswer: At least 10 feet
questions.explanation: You must stop at least 10 feet away from the bus, whether you are behind it or coming toward it.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — School Buses

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, when do you NOT have to stop for a school bus with flashing red lights?
options: When you are on the opposite side of a divided highway separated by a barrier or median
questions.correctAnswer: When you are on the opposite side of a divided highway separated by a barrier or median
questions.explanation: If you are driving on the opposite side of a divided highway (barriers, guide rails, trees or a median), you do not have to stop.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — School Buses

questions.question: What is the penalty in Pennsylvania for failing to stop for a school bus with flashing red lights and its stop arm extended?
options: A 60-day license suspension, five points and a fine
questions.correctAnswer: A 60-day license suspension, five points and a fine
questions.explanation: Failure to stop results in a 60-day suspension, five points on your record and a fine.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — School Buses

questions.question: Under Pennsylvania's Steer Clear Law, what must you do when approaching an emergency response area?
options: Move into a lane not adjacent to the area, or reduce speed if you can't move over
questions.correctAnswer: Move into a lane not adjacent to the area, or reduce speed if you can't move over
questions.explanation: The Steer Clear Law requires motorists to move into a lane not adjacent to an emergency response area, or reduce speed if unable to move over.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — Steer Clear Law

questions.question: After an emergency vehicle passes you in Pennsylvania, how far should you stay behind it?
questions.correctAnswer: At least 500 feet
questions.explanation: Pull over and stop; start driving again after the emergency vehicle passes, keeping at least 500 feet away from it.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — Emergency Vehicles and Situations

questions.question: When driving through a Pennsylvania work zone, what must you do with your lights?
options: Turn on your headlights, not just daytime running lights
questions.correctAnswer: Turn on your headlights, not just daytime running lights
questions.explanation: You must turn on your vehicle's headlights, not just the daytime running lights, in work zones.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — Work Zones

questions.question: What happens to fines for speeding in an active Pennsylvania work zone?
questions.correctAnswer: They are doubled
questions.explanation: Fines are doubled for certain violations in active work zones, including speeding.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — Work Zones

questions.question: When approaching or passing a bicyclist in Pennsylvania, you should:
options: Slow down to a safe speed
questions.correctAnswer: Slow down to a safe speed
questions.explanation: When approaching or passing a bicycle, slow down to a safe speed.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Special Circumstances and Emergencies — Sharing the Road With Pedestrians, Bicyclists, and Motorcyclists

questions.question: On dry pavement, Pennsylvania's manual recommends a following distance of at least:
questions.correctAnswer: 4 seconds
questions.explanation: A 4-second following distance lets you steer or brake to avoid a hazard safely when the pavement is dry.

questions.question: If you do not have at least how much space on one side of your vehicle as an escape path, Pennsylvania's manual says to increase your following distance?
questions.correctAnswer: 8 feet
questions.explanation: Without at least 8 feet of space on at least one side, allow more space in front by increasing following distance.

questions.question: If someone is tailgating you in Pennsylvania, what should you do if possible?
options: Move over to the right lane
questions.correctAnswer: Move over to the right lane
questions.explanation: If someone is following too closely, move over to the right lane if possible.

questions.question: What is the maximum speed limit in Pennsylvania?
questions.correctAnswer: 70 mph
questions.explanation: The maximum speed limit in Pennsylvania is 70 mph.

questions.question: In a Pennsylvania school zone with flashing lights, the speed limit is:
questions.correctAnswer: 15 mph
questions.explanation: In school zones, the speed limit is 15 mph when the lights on the school zone sign are flashing or during the posted times.

questions.question: Can you be ticketed in Pennsylvania while driving within the posted speed limit?
options: Yes, for driving too fast for conditions
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, for driving too fast for conditions
questions.explanation: Even within the posted limit, you can be ticketed for driving too fast for conditions.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, you may not park within how many feet of a fire hydrant?
questions.correctAnswer: 15 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, you may not park within how many feet of a crosswalk at an intersection?
questions.correctAnswer: 20 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, you may not park within how many feet of a stop sign, yield sign or flashing signal at the side of the road?
questions.correctAnswer: 30 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 30 feet of any flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign or traffic control device at the side of a roadway.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, you may not park within how many feet of the nearest rail at a railroad crossing?
questions.correctAnswer: 50 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 50 feet of the nearest rail at a railroad crossing.

questions.question: When parallel parking along a curb in Pennsylvania, how close must you be?
questions.correctAnswer: No more than 12 inches
questions.explanation: Park as close to the curb as you can, but no more than 12 inches away.

questions.question: When parking downhill in Pennsylvania, which way should your front wheels point?
questions.correctAnswer: Completely to the right
questions.explanation: When parking downhill, turn your steering wheel so your wheels are completely to the right.

questions.question: At a Pennsylvania four-way stop, if two vehicles arrive at the same time, who goes first?
questions.correctAnswer: The driver on the right
questions.explanation: If two vehicles reach the intersection at the same time, the driver on the left yields to the driver on the right.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, drivers turning left must yield to:
questions.correctAnswer: Oncoming vehicles going straight ahead
questions.explanation: Drivers turning left must yield to oncoming vehicles going straight ahead.

questions.question: When entering a roundabout in Pennsylvania, you must yield to:
options: Drivers waiting to enter behind you
questions.correctAnswer: Drivers already in the circle
questions.explanation: Drivers entering a roundabout must yield the right-of-way to drivers already in the circle.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, a driver entering a road from a driveway or alley must:
options: Wait until the main road is clear
questions.correctAnswer: Wait until the main road is clear
questions.explanation: A vehicle entering a public highway from an alley, private road or driveway must wait until the main road is clear.

questions.question: Pennsylvania's manual says to signal how long before a turn?
questions.correctAnswer: Three to four seconds
questions.explanation: Signal three to four seconds before your turn.

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, you may not pass within how many feet of an intersection or railroad crossing?
questions.correctAnswer: 100 feet
questions.explanation: You may not pass within 100 feet of or while crossing any intersection or railroad grade crossing.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Turning, Merging, and Passing — You May Not Pass If

questions.question: On a two-lane, two-way road in Pennsylvania, where should you make a left turn from?
options: The right edge of the road
As close to the centerline as possible
questions.correctAnswer: As close to the centerline as possible
questions.explanation: On two-lane, two-way streets, make left turns from as close to the centerline as possible.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 3: Turning, Merging, and Passing — Left and Right Turns

questions.question: Under Pennsylvania's Child Restraint Law, children under age 4 must ride in:
options: A federally approved child passenger restraint system
questions.correctAnswer: A federally approved child passenger restraint system
questions.explanation: Children under 4 must be buckled into a federally approved child passenger restraint system.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 5: Laws and Related Issues — Child Restraint Law

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, children ages 4 through 7 must ride in:
options: Any seat with a lap belt
questions.correctAnswer: A federally approved booster seat
questions.explanation: Children 4 and older but under 8 must be buckled into a federally approved child booster seat.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 5: Laws and Related Issues — Child Restraint Law

questions.question: In Pennsylvania, passengers age 8 through 17 must wear seat belts:
options: No matter where they ride in the vehicle
Only if the driver is under 18
questions.correctAnswer: No matter where they ride in the vehicle
questions.explanation: Passengers age 8 or older but under 18 must wear seat belts no matter where they are riding.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 5: Laws and Related Issues — Seat Belt Law

questions.question: What is the fine for violating Pennsylvania's anti-texting law?
questions.explanation: Violating the anti-texting law is a primary summary offense carrying a $50 fine.
questions.sourceSection: Chapter 5: Laws and Related Issues — Anti-Texting Law
